claim: A run reaches a win screen after three missions and 48 correct moves.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; play every called move and assert the win summary

claim: A paced real run lasts at least 14 minutes, and a representative couch session takes about 18 minutes.
sandbox: deterministic real game; complete all 48 moves at the enforced 17.5-second cadence, then complete a representative run at 19 seconds per move with briefing time
two identical seeded games; tick regular and calm modes for five seconds and compare pressure
sample run; lose, replay, and assert the seeded sample starting state

claim: Touch and number-key controls both advance the route.
sandbox: fresh /demo; make one correct pointer press and one correct keyboard press

claim: The game assigns five roles for crews of 3–6 players.
sandbox: fresh home page; choose 3, 4, 5, and 6 players and assert all five role assignments for each crew size

claim: Friends join anonymous four-letter rooms and receive phone-specific role controls.
sandbox: local host creates a room; a 390 px phone context joins and is assigned its own role controls

claim: Settings and an unfinished run persist in this browser.
sandbox: fresh real-mode local storage; enable calm pressure, advance one move, reload, and assert both the setting and unfinished route recover

claim: Demo mode saves no game data.
sandbox: fresh browser storage at /demo; play a move and assert no Couch Crew localStorage keys

claim: The demo makes no third-party network requests.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request during the demo and require same-origin URLs

claim: Real play loads no analytics, advertising, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh real-mode browser context; record document requests and WebSocket endpoints, allowing only the same-origin game and Couch Crew room service

claim: The game reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new service-worker context; visit /demo, go offline, reload, and inspect the live game

claim: Couch Crew is free and has no account step.
sandbox: fresh home page; verify no credential fields, buy links, or checkout controls

claim: The game simulation uses a fixed 60 Hz timestep.
sandbox: assert the exported deterministic simulation rate is 60 ticks per second

claim: The live game renders at 60 frames per second on a 390 px screen.
sandbox: isolated one-worker 390 px demo; warm the live loop, measure five 60-frame requestAnimationFrame samples, and assert the median stays within the real 50–65 fps floor

claim: The room service accepts browser sockets only from Couch Crew and local development origins.
sandbox: ephemeral local room server; assert production and localhost origins connect while hostile and deceptive origins receive 403

claim: Each client gets 8 room openings and 60 health checks per minute; the next request receives 429 with Retry-After.
sandbox: ephemeral local room server with production limits; assert openings 1–8 and health checks 1–60 pass, then assert each next request returns 429 and Retry-After 60

claim: A completed or lost run removes its recovery save.
sandbox: fresh real-mode browser storage; reach both win and loss states and assert the unfinished-run key is deleted after each
